name: Omneky
summary: AI ad platform that generates image and video ads, including avatar and clone videos, launches them to Meta, Google, TikTok and other channels, and reports performance per creative.
best_for: e-commerce brands and performance marketers who want AI-generated image and video ads launched and measured across Meta, Google, TikTok and other channels from one place
skip_if: you need a predictable number of ads per month before you buy, you manage more than five brands without an enterprise contract, or you only need simple static banners
honest_knock: The pricing page gives credits per month (200, 1,000 or 4,000) but not what an image or video costs in credits, so you cannot tell from it how many ads a plan produces. Lite allows one brand, one seat and one connected ad channel, and avatar and clone videos start on Standard at $99 a month. We have not used Omneky ourselves.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-09 in a browser render of the pricing section on omneky.com, USD, monthly view; omneky.com/pricing itself rendered empty) Lite is $29 a month with 200 credits a month, 1 brand, 1 team seat and 1 connected ad channel, plus insights, AI product image and video generation, the ad and campaign launcher and brand rules. Standard is $99 a month with 1,000 credits, 3 brands and 3 seats, and adds forecasting and budget planning, AI ad scoring, commercial-grade video, avatar videos, storyboards and clone video. Pro is $249 a month with 4,000 credits, 5 brands and 5 seats, and adds AI scoring with recommendations, long-form storyboard videos, character replacement and creative expert ad packages. Enterprise is custom and adds training on your first-party data, custom integrations, dedicated success, an SLA with IP assignment and media-buying services. All plans include a 7-day free trial and can be cancelled any time; yearly billing is said to save up to 20%, but we did not read the yearly prices. The page does not say how many credits an image or a video costs.
